data.title: 双叶理央 · 夜行列车上的星图
data.description: 理央穿深色棉服和围巾，坐在夜行列车窗边，展开随身星图，用手指对照窗外海湾上方的一颗亮星。保温杯稳稳放在小桌上，车厢暖灯照亮眼镜后的双眼；座椅、窗框与远处灯火铺满整个横向画面。
data.action: 展开星图指向一处星位，抬眼核对海湾上方的亮星。
data.mood: 理性旅途里突然亮起的星光
data.promptProse: Rio Futaba sits beside the train compartment's small table, one fingertip on an unfolded star chart while she checks a bright star above the bay through the broad window. A thermos stands beside the paper. Her dark padded jacket and wool scarf fill the horizontal medium view against continuous upholstery. The overhead reading light warms her glasses, brown eyes and chart; the window holds cooler bay darkness beyond her shoulder.
